comments.body:
Root cause (confirmed from history): ADR 0085 kept the live module out of `make test` only through `-m "not integration and not external"`; no selection ever excluded `live` itself. Commit 504b85c324f ("Run the integration tier in make test", 2026-11-01, bug a8af-ac33-74aa-4ccd) added `pytest -m integration` to `make test` for CI parity, which pulled the whole `[integration, live]` module back into every local run. Only `test_delete_permission_probe` (`@_requires_live`) reaches Jira; the other 15 tests in the module are deterministic and execute in CI today.

Second production-reaching test found: `tests/interfaces/facades/test_cli.py::test_bridge_preview_against_live_jira` is `integration` (not `live`) and runs a live Jira dry-run whenever `acli` and `JIRA_PROJECT` are present.

Plan (mirrors how `external` is kept out: a marker exclusion applied identically locally and in CI):
1. Move the `live` mark from module scope onto the credential-backed tests only (the delete probe and the bridge preview), so `live` means "reaches a real Jira".
2. Integration tier becomes `-m "integration and not live"` in both the Makefile `test` recipe and `_build-and-test.yml`, so parity holds. CI loses no executed coverage: both excluded tests always skip in CI (no credentials, no acli).
3. `scripts/run_live_matrix.py` selects the matrix by file path (drop `-m live`) so the d01e report keeps all 16 cases.
4. Opt-in stays `pytest <path> -m live` with credentials; update the module docstring, the `live` marker text, ADR 0085 note, runbook, docs and AGENTS.md.
5. Collect-only test: the `make test` selections AND `live` collect nothing with JIRA_URL/JIRA_USER/JIRA_API_TOKEN set to placeholders.

comments.body: Implemented as commit bb3125f6c9a (local, pre-push). Red first: with JIRA_URL/JIRA_USER/JIRA_API_TOKEN set to placeholders, collect-only of make test's selections AND live collected test_delete_permission_probe and test_bridge_preview_against_live_jira. Green: both make test selections AND live collect 0 of 21138 nodes. Parity found one more gap: macOS's default route 'platform_compat and not external' would select a hypothetical platform_compat+live test that make test no longer selects, so that route now ends 'and not live' (no live test is platform_compat today). 1979 related tests passed, make lint and make typecheck pass. make verify running with Jira vars unset.

compiled_state.description:
## Observation
tests/integration/test_reconcile_live_e2e.py is marked integration + live and is skipped only when JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, JIRA_API_TOKEN and acli are all absent. make verify's integration tier selects -m integration, so it runs these tests whenever the shell has those variables. On the operator host they are always present: ~/.zshenv exports JIRA_URL and JIRA_USER, and secrets-load publishes JIRA_API_TOKEN to every shell. On 2026-11-04 a local make verify (subsolar-sonorous-puppy, Gerrit 3304) created and deleted live issue REB-6995 through test_delete_permission_probe. The module docstring says the credential-backed cases are run with -m live, which reads as an explicit opt-in, but the gate does not require it. CI's gating cells have no Jira credentials, so local and CI runs of the 'same' tier differ by environment. A read-only JQL search on 2026-11-04 found no leftover DELETE-ME-d01e issues since 2026-11-03.

## Why it matters
The pre-push gate every contributor and agent is told to run writes to a shared production Jira project, and any teardown failure leaves stray issues there.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] make verify (and make test) never select a live-marked test, regardless of which credentials are in the environment; running the live cases requires an explicit opt-in recorded in the module docstring and docs.
- [ ] tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py (or its equivalent) still holds: the local tiers remain a superset of CI's gating selection.
- [ ] A test asserts the make test selection excludes the live marker even with JIRA_URL/JIRA_USER/JIRA_API_TOKEN set.
compiled_state.title: Local make verify writes to live Jira when creds are set
